name: C-phase-visibility
description: C: slow partial input_json_delta streaming holds the client-side `preparing` phase for ~4s, then a genuinely slow tool execution (Start-Sleep 4000ms) holds the dispatched `start`/running phase for ~4s. Both in-progress states must be captured before the result settles.

toolInput.description: Hold the tool row in the running state for four seconds

responses.text: The slow command finished; the tool card settled.
